name: InuSaitama
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: InuSaitama is suspected to have suffered an arbitrage attack. The attacker (0xAd0C834315Abfa7A800bBBB5d776A0B07b672614) Saitamask (0x00480b0abBd14F2d61Aa2E801d483132e917C18B) exchanged almost 10 times the value of SAITAMA Token through swap, and then exchanged it back to ETH through uniswap, and transferred it to 0x63493e679155c2f0aAd5Bf96d65725AD6427faC4, with a total profit of about 4.
